LIVE: STURLE DAGSLAND (NO)
Sturle Dagsland is an acclaimed, genre-defying Norwegian artist whose wild and unique performances take audiences on an intense, adventurous journey. Together with his brother Sjur, he has toured festivals around the world, from Shanghai to New York.
Their music combines extraordinary vocals, experimental folk, avant-garde pop and immersive electronic soundscapes. Moving between ethereal beauty and raw, explosive energy, their performances challenge musical conventions and invite you to lose yourself in sound. Expect the unexpected.
“Indescribable!” — VICE
“Extraordinary!” — The Independent
“Unlike anything I have ever seen!” — The Quietus

EXHIBITION: COLLAGES FOR JUSTICE
Olga Borkowska (NO/PL)
Visual artist Olga Borkowska presents a series of politically charged collages examining contemporary society through a feminist and activist lens. Her work addresses human rights, gender equality and resistance to war.
Combining archival materials, text, photography and graphic design, Borkowska creates layered compositions that serve as both artistic testimony and forms of protest. Drawing on personal experience and wider political realities, her collages highlight the struggles of women, LGBTQ+ people and marginalized communities confronting nationalism, militarization and social injustice.
